name: Focus On Me 2
source:
The direct sequel to Focus On Me, which starts off as a comedy and slowly transitions back to horror. We see Monika struggling with her existence and how she relates to You. Don’t let the expertly placed jumpscares impair your mind, because you're decisions can have fatal consequences…

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200511220448/http://ddlcmods.com/focus-on-me-2/]DDLCmods[/url]]
translation:
《聚焦我》的直接续集，一开始是一部喜剧，然后慢慢过渡到恐怖。我们看到莫妮卡在她的存在以及她与你的关系中挣扎。不要让精心放置的跳跃恐惧损害你的思想，因为你的决定可能会产生致命的后果……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200511220448/http://ddlcmods.com/focus-on-me-2/]DDLCmods[/url]]
